intent: A creator whose improvement round proposed several candidates can try each candidate as a real version on the round's test cases, see which one is recommended, and adopt one into the Skill, without any candidate becoming the Skill's face before it is adopted.
observable_outcome: POST .../reflections/{id}/evaluate builds one held version per candidate and launches one batch each on the round's test cases; POST .../adopt promotes one candidate's version into the Skill's line; the version list marks held and promoted versions and GET /skills/{id}/candidate-versions names each held version's round and candidate.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A held candidate takes the next version number but the Skill's newest stays the round's base; it is not released, enriched or indexed, and a round cannot be started from its batch.
Adopting a candidate makes its version the Skill's newest only while the newest is still the round's base, once, with one enrichment.
A candidate is kept on development cases and recommended on held-out cases only after every built candidate's batch settles.
Evaluating accepts each candidate's pending suggestions by the user who asked and records rejected ones as skipped; a candidate with only rejected suggestions is unavailable.
A round adopts at most one built candidate; adopting another answers 409; a lost adoption row is healed by adopting again.
A crash during evaluation is healed by retrying with one version and one batch per candidate and no orphan batch.
